title: Bound for a finite running minimum
statement: Let $\beta$ be a linearly ordered type, let $f:\mathbb{N}\to\beta$, and let $m$ be a natural number. For every natural number $k\le m$, the minimum obtained by starting with $f(0)$ and successively taking the minimum with $f(1),\ldots,f(m)$ is at most $f(k)$.
